name: QoS Network Tweaks
description: Removes aggressive bandwidth reservation settings in Windows to allow more flexible network traffic handling during gaming or streaming. This does not increase your internet speed but may help reduce background throttling on some systems.

description_i18n.en: Removes aggressive bandwidth reservation settings in Windows to allow more flexible network traffic handling during gaming or streaming. This does not increase your internet speed but may help reduce background throttling on some systems.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt aggressive Bandbreitenreservierungseinstellungen in Windows, um den Netzwerkverkehr beim Gaming oder Streaming flexibler zu handhaben. Dies erhöht nicht die Internetgeschwindigkeit, kann aber das Hintergrund-Drosseln auf manchen Systemen reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les paramètres de réservation de bande passante agressifs dans Windows pour permettre une gestion plus flexible du trafic réseau pendant le jeu ou le streaming. Cela n'augmente pas la vitesse d'internet mais peut réduire l'étranglement en arrière-plan sur certains systèmes.

warnings.title: Reboot recommended
warnings.message: Changes may not take full effect until the system is restarted. A reboot ensures all network services apply new settings correctly

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies registry values at HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched and HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile Specifically sets NonBestEffortLimit to 0, NetworkThrottlingIndex to maximum value (FFFFFFFF), and SystemResponsiveness to 0
